provider.description: Configured local provider used for contextual PII scanning.

model.description: Local model used for PII scanning.

tools.description: Tool-name allowlist; * scans every tool result.

on_error.description: Fail closed or open if the contextual scanner cannot decide.

max_scan_bytes.description: Maximum tool-output BYTES sent to the local scanner (rune-safe); zero is unbounded. Content beyond the limit is an incomplete scan governed by on_error and is never cached as clean.
